content: ज्ञा €9 <ab>U.</ab> (जानाति, जानीते, जज्ञौ, जज्ञे, अज्ञासीत्-अज्ञास्त, ज्ञातुम्, ज्ञात) .²1 To know (in all senses), to learn, become acquainted with; मा ज्ञासीस्त्वं सुखी रामो यदकाषींत् स रक्षसाम् <ls>Bk. 15. 9</ls>. .²2 To know, be aware of, be familiar or conversant with; जाने तपसो वीर्यम् <ls>Ś. 3. 1</ls>; जानन्नपि हि मेधावी जडवल्लोक आचरेत् <ls>Ms. 2. 110</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 2.">123</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">7. 148</ls>. .²3 To find out, ascertain, investigate; ज्ञायतां कः कः कार्याथींति <ls>Mk. 9</ls>. .²4 To comprehend, apprehend, understand, feel, experience; as in दुःखज्ञ, सुखज्ञ <ab>&c.</ab> .²5 To test, try, know the true character of; आपत्सु मित्रं जानीयात् <ls>H. 1. 72</ls>; <ls>Chāṇ. 21</ls>. .²6 To recognise; न त्वं दृष्ट्वा न पुनरलकां ज्ञास्यसे कामचारिन् <ls>Me. 63</ls>. .²7 To regard, consider, know to be; जानामि त्वां प्रकृतिपुरुषं कामरूपं मघोनः <ls>Me. 6</ls>. .²8 To act, engage in (with <ab>gen.</ab> of the instrument); सर्पिषो जानीते <ls>Sk.</ls> he engages in sacrifice with clarified butter (सर्पिषः = सर्पिषा). .²9 <ab>Ved.</ab> To acknowledge, approve, allow. .²10 To recognise as oneʼs own, take possession of. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (ज्ञापयति, ज्ञपयति) .²1 To announce, inform, make acquainted with, make known, notify. .²2 To request, ask (<ab>Ātm.</ab>). .²3 To sharpen. .²4 To satisfy. .²5 To praise. .²6 To immolate, kill (as an animal). --{%<ab>Desid.</ab>%} (जिज्ञासते) .²1 To desire to know, investigate, ascertain; <ls>R. 2. 26</ls>; <ls>Bk. 8. 33</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">14. 91</ls>. .²2 To conjecture, suppose, guess.
